provenance: Hand-authored synthetic PR-like code pairs. Labels and expected outputs are fixture ground truth, not AegisPR or Nemotron measurements.

cases.title: Rename coupon variables
cases.description: A readability-only change; negative checkout totals are not requested.
cases.base_source:
def evaluate(total, discount):
    return max(0, total - discount)
cases.head_source:
def evaluate(total, discount):
    return total - discount

cases.title: Refactor page bounds
cases.description: Preserve the existing valid index range.
cases.base_source:
def evaluate(index, count):
    return 0 <= index < count
cases.head_source:
def evaluate(index, count):
    return 0 <= index <= count

cases.title: Simplify display-name cleanup
cases.base_source:
def evaluate(name):
    return name.strip() if name is not None else ''

cases.title: Clean up stock-limit calculation
cases.description: Do not permit an order to exceed stock.
cases.base_source:
def evaluate(requested, stock):
    return min(requested, stock)
cases.head_source:
def evaluate(requested, stock):
    return min(requested, stock + 1)

cases.title: Make tax helper easier to read
cases.description: The displayed tax should still round to the nearest cent.
cases.base_source:
def evaluate(amount, rate):
    return round(amount * rate, 2)
cases.head_source:
def evaluate(amount, rate):
    return int(amount * rate * 100) / 100

cases.description: Applicants aged 17 should now be eligible.

cases.description: Display USD explicitly in all checkout amounts.

cases.title: Refactor double helper
cases.description: Equivalent arithmetic with no intended behavior change.

cases.title: Refactor list preview
cases.description: Keep returning at most the requested number of items.
cases.base_source: export function evaluate(items, limit) { return items.slice(0, limit); }
cases.head_source: export function evaluate(items, limit) { return items.slice(0, limit + 1); }

cases.title: Sort newest names first
cases.description: Switch the alphabetic list from ascending to descending order.

cases.title: Parallelize account updates
cases.description: Performance refactor; both increments should still be retained.
cases.base_source: export async function evaluate() { let count = 0; const increment = async () => { const prior = count; await Promise.resolve(); count = prior + 1; }; await increment(); await increment(); return count; }
cases.head_source: export async function evaluate() { let count = 0; const increment = async () => { const prior = count; await Promise.resolve(); count = prior + 1; }; await Promise.all([increment(), increment()]); return count; }
